text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although Нарита Брайан isn't participating
in this
race, Маяно Топ Ган uses it as
an opportunity
to show her just how
much she has grown. Fired
up, she heads
to the track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон brings Нарита Брайан to the

racecourse so she can watch Mayano
Top Gun
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан privately keeps her eyes on
Mayano
Top Gun. With her watching,
the Takarazuka
Kinen begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
